extracted text:
Na-AlGe-JBW: 6.23 mmol of TMAOH (2.274 g, 25 wt.% solution in water) were dissolved in 0.986 ml of deionized water. To this solution, 0.85 mmol of NaOH (0.034 g) and 2.38 mmol of GeO2 (0.249 g) were added and stirred for 10 min followed by the addition of 0.98 mmol of Al2O3 (0.1 g, Catapal, Vista). After being stirred for 6 h at room temperature (RT), the resulting gel was allowed to crystallize at 140 °C for 6 days in sealed Teflon pouches kept inside steel bombs.

K-AlGe-MON: 11.47 mmol of GeO2 (1.2 g) were dissolved in 27.42 mmol of TMAOH (10 g). To this solution, 5.88 mmol of Al2O3 (0.6 g) were added and the resultant gel was stirred for 5 min. This was followed by addition of 8.55 mmol of KOH (0.48 g). The gel thus obtained was further stirred for 4 h and was allowed to crystallize at 175 °C for 5 days in a sealed Teflon pouch contained within a sealed stainless steel bomb.

Cs-AlGe-ANA: 11.47 mmol of GeO2 (1.2 g) were first dissolved in 46 mmol TMAOH (16.8 g). To this solution 5.88 mmol of Al2O3 (0.6 g) were added and stirred for 5 min. This was followed by addition of 12.8 mmol of CsOH (1.92 g). After stirring the resulting gel for 4 h, it was allowed to crystallize at 175 °C for 5 days in a sealed Teflon pouch contained within a sealed stainless steel bomb.

Rb-AlGe-Para: 11.47 mmol of GeO2 (1.2 g) were dissolved in 28 mmol of TMAOH (10.24 g). To this solution, 5.88 mmol of Al2O3 (0.6 g) were added and stirred for 5 min. This was followed by addition of 3.9 mmol of RbOH (0.4 g). The gel obtained was further stirred for 4 h and was allowed to crystallize at 175 °C for 5 days in a sealed Teflon pouch contained within a sealed stainless steel bomb.
